declarations.description:
A checkbox with native `<input type="checkbox">` behaviour. The visible box sits centred in a square touch target
(`state-layer--size`) that doubles as the hover layer; that layer is transparent unless a
`state-layer__hover__*--color` is set, so the default look is quiet. Text in the default slot becomes the
checkbox's label (clicking it toggles the box), with an optional `description` underneath; without either the
element is the bare box. Put several in a `c2-checkbox-group` for one value array.
declarations.name: Checkbox

cssProperties.description: Space between the box's touch target and the label.
cssProperties.name: --c2-checkbox__field--gap

cssParts.name: checkmark

cssParts.description: Wrapper containing the `mixedmark` slot or fallback mark while indeterminate.
cssParts.name: mixedmark

cssParts.description: Wrapper containing the optional `uncheckmark` slot while unchecked.
cssParts.name: uncheckmark

cssParts.description: Region containing the default slot (the label text).
cssParts.name: label

cssParts.name: description

slots.name: mixedmark

declarations.description:
Groups `c2-checkbox` options into one form control with one value array — the multi-select counterpart of
`c2-radio-group`. The group owns the `name` (every checked option is submitted under it), group-level `disabled`
and a `required` rule meaning "at least one". Options may sit anywhere inside the group, wrapped in other elements,
and each stays its own tab stop, as native checkboxes are. The `label` and `description` slots name the group for
assistive technology (`role="group"`).
declarations.name: CheckboxGroup

cssProperties.description: `stretch` makes card-style options fill the width.
cssProperties.name: --c2-checkbox-group--align-items

cssProperties.description: Space between the label and the description.
cssProperties.name: --c2-checkbox-group__header--gap

cssProperties.description: Space between the header and the options.
cssProperties.name: --c2-checkbox-group__header--margin-bottom

slots.description: The `c2-checkbox` options, optionally inside wrapper elements. Give each a `value` and label text.
Group heading, announced as the group's name.
slots.name: label

members.name: adopted
members.description: Until the options have been read once, syncing would uncheck the pre-checked ones before they are adopted.

members.name: value
members.description:
`value` of every checked option, in document order. Setting it checks exactly the matching options. As an
attribute, the values are separated by `;` (`value="email;sms"`).

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. Every checked option is submitted under it; leave the options themselves unnamed.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables every option.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires at least one option to be checked for the form to be valid.

members.name: orientation
members.description: Lays the options out in a row instead of a column.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the group when its heading does not label it.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: checkboxes
members.description: The `c2-checkbox` elements of this group (nested groups keep their own), in DOM order.

members.name: adoptCheckboxes
members.description: Options may upgrade after the group; wait for them, then adopt pre-checked options when no value was given.

members.name: syncCheckboxes
members.description: Mirrors `value` and the group's disabled state onto the options.

events.description: Fired when the user toggles an option, before `change`. Read the group's `value`.
events.name: input

events.description: Fired after the user toggles an option. `detail.value` is the new `value`. Not fired for programmatic changes.
events.name: change
